claims.citation: New York Herald, 25 September 1866, p. 8, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Ship Mary (of Boston), Hall, Newcastle, E, 39 days, with
coal, to master. Sept 8, lat 46, lon 47, saw two large icebergs;
11th, lat 45 05, lon 50 50, signalized steamship Carroll, bound
E; had heavy westerly winds most of the passage.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 26 September 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Ship Mary (of Boston), which arrived at this port 24th inst
from Newcastle, is consigned to C L Wright & Co.

Ship Mary (of Boston), Hall, Newcastle, Eng., 31 days, with coal to
master. Sept. 8[?], in lat. 45, long. 47, saw two large icebergs. Sept. 11,
in lat. 45 05, long. 50 50, signaled American steamship Carroll, bound
east; heavy westerly winds most of the passage.
